about: Owning cases of the snapshot: layers, merge, provenance, trusted root, confined accounts and refusals. A case writes files under project/, main/ (the trusted root, when present) and home/.fgos/ (global; private/accounts.yaml) and takes detected values from `detect`. Expect: at (path to value), absent, prov [path, layer, role, file, line, column], undescribed, described, accounts, absent_sources, errors [code, path, file, line, column, keyword, layers].
